visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A brown and white Shiba Inu sits inside a black pet stroller positioned on a light gray stone floor. A male character in a gray jacket stands behind it. Yellow and white text overlays appear at the top. The scene cuts to the interior of a car where the dog is being fed a small yellow snack by a hand. (2) The Shiba Inu stands on a wooden floor, sniffing a large cardboard box labeled 'TAVO Maeve 7X'. The scene shifts to the man walking the dog in a stroller outside a department store with 'SOGO' signage. They enter a pop-up event area with artificial green turf and a white trailer. (3) The dog is seen on a white fluffy shell-shaped chair and inside a car seat setup within a vehicle. Close-ups show the mechanical ISOFIX attachment and a black mesh safety cover. The lighting is bright and even. The man interacts with the dog, patting its head. (4) An AI photo booth is demonstrated, showing a screen with adventure-themed options. Printed photos of the dog and man are displayed. The dog sits near pet bowls and toys. The video concludes with the man leading the dog on a leash through an outdoor plaza.
